summary: File chooser with a browse button or a drag-and-drop zone that lists the chosen files with remove buttons and submits them with a form.

usage.text: The form receives one entry per file under name, and nothing without a name; submit it as multipart/form-data. The value property is always empty; read files, an array of File.
input and change carry detail.files, a copy of the File array. Removing a file also fires remove with detail { file, index, files }.
Without multiple, a new choice replaces the file. With it, each choice or drop adds to the list, skipping duplicates; take files out with removeFileAt(index) or clearFiles().
accept, max-files and max-file-size (bytes) are checked on every choice and drop. A failing selection is rejected whole, the current files stay, and the reason is shown as the error.
Drag and drop works only with appearance="dropzone", where a click anywhere on the zone also opens the picker. The default appearance="button" is a browse button only.
setFiles(files) applies the same checks and returns false when it rejects them. openPicker() opens the system file dialog and needs a user gesture.

a11y.text: The browse button is named "<label>: Browse file" ("Browse files" with multiple, "Replace file" once a single file is chosen). The native file input is hidden from assistive technology.
The selection summary is a polite status region, so each new choice is announced. Every listed file has its own remove button named "Remove <file name>".
